summary_en: This study tests genomically guided radiation therapy, which personalizes the radiation dose using a genomic score, in people with triple negative breast cancer who have had breast-conserving surgery. Radiation is given once daily, 5 days per week, with a total dose of 50 Gy in 25 fractions or 42.56 Gy in 16 fractions, with or without a 10 Gy boost in 5 fractions to the cavity. The study's purpose is to determine whether this approach is feasible, and it is a Phase II study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa la radioterapia guiada por genómica, que personaliza la dosis de radiación usando una puntuación genómica, en personas con cáncer de mama triple negativo que se han sometido a cirugía conservadora de mama. La radiación se administra una vez al día, 5 días por semana, con una dosis total de 50 Gy en 25 fracciones o de 42.56 Gy en 16 fracciones, con o sin un refuerzo de 10 Gy en 5 fracciones en la cavidad. El objetivo del estudio es determinar si este enfoque es factible, y es un estudio de Fase II.
who_for: Had breast-conserving surgery (lumpectomy) with axillary evaluation by sentinel node biopsy or axillary dissection
Triple negative breast cancer confirmed by tissue biopsy
Enough tissue available to calculate the RSI score
Age 18 or older, life expectancy over 16 weeks, and KPS 70 or higher
not_for: Allergy or hypersensitivity to any study drug or component
Major surgery or significant traumatic injury not recovered from within 14 days
